long_session_comparison.interpretation: All issued tasks are primary. Conditional behavioral regressions are not a causal estimate of compaction loss. Common eligibility is selected by pre-behavior. Native pruning, durable/context contents and loss mechanism remain unknown without separate evidence. Short runs do not demonstrate long-duration reliability; no superiority inference from this development batch.
